name: fintrack
description: FinTrack monorepo helper scripts (each package has its own package.json)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/transaction-service && npm install --prefix services/notification-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix gateway && npm run lint --prefix services/auth-service && npm run lint --prefix services/transaction-service && npm run lint --prefix services/notification-service && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix gateway && npm test --prefix services/auth-service && npm test --prefix services/transaction-service && npm test --prefix services/notification-service
